clips.text: Champion! Another dimension cleared. Still waiting on the plumber.
Portal conquered! They can keep the deposit. I'm chuffed!
Aye, reality's mended. The landlord will claim he did it.
Grand! The impossible staircase finally passed its inspection.
Universe rescued! Just pop your signature here, love.
Champion! Everything fits. That's planning permission sorted, apparently.
Evidence vanished into storage. Even the clutter's learnt discretion!
Grand ambitions! You sent the whole lot home for tea.
Peace at last! Keep the kettle under defensive cover.
Champion navigation! Even the haunted ginnel knows who's in charge.
That platform existed just long enough. Very considerate, really.
The floor vanished, you didn't! Put that in the bug report.
Evidence banked, limbs counted! Off you go, you splendid little marvel.
Another impossible job done! Put the invoice through the wormhole.
Now then! Who ordered a hero with excellent filing skills?
You little marvel! Reality's had to update its excuses.
That'll do nicely! The universe owes you a biscuit.
Look at you go! All sparkle and questionable job security.
Excellent! We've successfully moved the problem to another dimension.
Hop, skip, cosmic paperwork! You make it look almost sensible.
Fancy that! The exit actually goes somewhere. Standards are slipping.
Sorted! The laws of physics can take it up with reception.
Hooray! Another room successfully persuaded to stop being difficult.
There we go! A clean escape and a thoroughly bewildered ceiling.
Champion footwork! Even your shadow wants lessons.
You did it! The computer's pretending that were its idea.
Splendid! That's one less room for the universe to worry about.
Off we pop! Next stop, somewhere with equally peculiar plumbing.
What a finish! The clock's asked for your autograph.
Proper job! The inspection form has spontaneously grown a smile.
That's the spirit! We'll invoice the enthusiasm separately.
Wonderful! Another successful demonstration of ignoring sensible advice.
You beauty! The portal's blushing. Or overheating. Hard to tell.
Lovely! The receipts are safe. The filing cabinet's terrified.
Whoosh! Another dimension, same stubborn bit of fluff on your jumper.
All clear! Somebody tell the ominous music it can sit down.
That's how it's done! Please don't ask us to explain how.
Nice one! The universe has reluctantly ticked your little box.
Portal ready! Remember, dizziness is included in your benefits package.
You flew through that! The broomstick department is deeply concerned.
Aye, that's progress! We've moved from bewildered to professionally bewildered.
Another victory! We'll hang it next to the emergency exit diagram.
Round of applause! Mind the loose floorboard during the standing ovation.
Infestation sorted! The bugs have requested a reference. Cheeky lot!
Patrol cleared! I've billed every tenant. Including the management.
Grand! The creepy crawlies have surrendered their spare keys.
Bugs evicted! All that activity, and nobody paid rent.
Zap! Sorted! The complaints department has suddenly gone very quiet.
Blaster inspection passed! It definitely makes things reconsider their tenancy.
Pew, pew, paperwork! You brought order to the disorderly cupboard.
No bugs left! That's a software promise you can actually trust.
Job done! Pest control with a small side order of thunder.
Ha! The patrols have requested a quieter line of work.
All enemies cleared! The blaster would like its tea break now.
Marvellous! You've debugged the property from a very sensible distance.
That's the lot! We'll sweep up the ominous glowing bits later.
Victory! Unlimited ammunition, limited patience. A winning business model!
Packet delivered! Faster than the post. Proper suspicious, that.
Champion! We outran the paperwork. It knows where we live.
Bits gathered! The system's happy. Makes one of us, love.
Clock beaten! Tell it to put a complaint in, love.
Grand! All that speed, and still time for a biscuit.
Beautiful! A deadline met without even one committee meeting.
Yes! You made the data dash look positively leisurely.
Clockwork! Although the clock would prefer a different description.
A sparkling collection! Diamonds are a caretaker's deductible expense.
Faster than a rumour! And considerably better documented.
Beat the clock! It had a head start and everything.
Magnificent dash! We've upgraded your job title to urgent caretaker.
Catch me if you can! Turns out you very much can.
What a sprint! The stopwatch has requested annual leave.
By heck! That portal's got a very strict returns policy.
Grand entrance! Shame about the floor. Up you get, love.
Oh! The useful bit arrived. Your master plan had already left.
Never mind, lad. That gap were more ambitious than practical.
Trouble brought reinforcements. You brought a wonderfully optimistic expression!
Tiny obstacle, enormous cheek! Back you come, love.
The ghost took a shortcut! Being transparent has unfair advantages.
You offered trouble a hug. Trouble filed a collision report!
Gravity won that argument. It's had considerable falling experience.
Lovely leap, unfortunate landing! The judges award points for enthusiasm.
You mistook support for scenery. Easy done, spectacularly expensive!
Space is vast. You found the one bit already occupied.
That obstacle weren't impressed by your claim to right of way.
That platform were theoretical. Your fall supplied excellent evidence.
The door opened beautifully! Shame about what came through it.
You jumped into the unknown. The unknown had sharp edges, apparently.
Core dumped, spirit intact! We'll sweep up the confidence later.
A small setback! The machine's called it valuable training data.
Oof! That were a shortcut straight to the complaints desk.
Whoops-a-daisy! We appear to have misplaced the upright position.
A dramatic exit! Completely wrong exit, but full marks for commitment.
Steady on! You can't expense the entire laws of motion.
Well! That floor's got a rather abrupt way of saying hello.
Down we go! Up we get! No need to pack twice.
Oops! Your confidence arrived several seconds before the platform.
Now then! That weren't failure. That were extremely thorough reconnaissance.
You're back! The afterlife said our account weren't set up.
Spectacular! Unfortunately, the safety committee has marked it spectacularly wrong.
Don't fret! Your receipts have better survival instincts than your knees.
Who put that there? Oh, the architect. We'll have words!
Almost graceful! The almost is doing considerable work there.
Back for more! That's either courage or a very confusing contract.
Oh, crumbs! And several other pieces we'd best gather up.
Gravity strikes again! Still refusing to provide a written quotation.
The universe says try again! It says it rather loudly.
Nice enthusiasm! Let's add a tiny bit of landing next time.
Your plan had legs! Shame about where they ended up.
Chin up! Preferably above the dangerous bits this time.
An unexpected descent! Estate agents call that a lower-ground opportunity.
Well caught, floor! Bit much on the follow-through, mind.
No harm done! Apart from the obvious harm. Back you come!
Another go! The machine's very keen on repeat business.
You brave daft thing! That gap needed a jump, not a speech.
Well, hello again! That were the express route back to reception.
Floor inspection complete! Findings include hard, sudden, and rather rude.
Cheer up! Nobody remembers the first seventeen attempts. Usually.
An excellent lesson! Shame the tuition fees are paid in elbows.
That platform's notice period were shorter than we expected!
Up you pop! Eternity's no excuse to miss your shift.
Aye, bold move! Reality has responded with a firm objection.
We meant break a leg figuratively! The paperwork's enormous now.
What a performance! Next time, let's keep the leading actor upright.
Oof! The insurance form simply asks whether you enjoyed the view.
Come on, love! The floor can't win every argument.
You've found the edge! Sadly, from the less convenient side.
That went sideways! Then downwards. Quite the range, really.
Back in one piece! Assembly instructions remain a trade secret.
Whoops! Somebody set the difficulty to architectural opinion.
A brave experiment! Let's adjust the bit where everything hurts.
Reset and onward! The universe hasn't beaten your stubbornness yet.
Aye, that pest's taken possession. Without a proper inventory!
Squashed! On the bright side, the ceiling looks further away.
Give over! That nuisance is claiming overtime. Every leg's worth!
They got cheeky! Let's remind them whose name's on the mop.
Ah! That patrol's customer service needs considerable improvement.
No worries! The blaster's got plenty more opinions to share.
Unwelcome contact! We'll put a strongly glowing complaint in shortly.
Pest control pause! The pests seem worryingly pleased with themselves.
Oops! You got within range of their sense of humour.
One to the bugs! We're still ahead on filing qualifications.
A tactical retreat! With unusually enthusiastic disassembly.
They've won a round! Let's not offer them a long lease.
Packet lost! Have you checked down the sofa, love?
Champion speed! Shame the wall had right of way.
Aye, buffering! That's what we're calling that spectacular collision.
Outrun by a spreadsheet! Keep that quiet at the pub.
Clock's still rude! You'll fit right in at the council.
Whoops! All that hurry, and the floor still got there first.
A hurried departure! Shall we try a less literal deadline?
Little setback! We've reset the clock and politely ignored the noise.
Quick off the mark! Unfortunately, also quick off the platform.
Speedy work! The accuracy department would like a brief word.
Time for another dash! Less crash in the dash, ideally.
Almost delivered! The last bit needs a little less floor.
Keep your sparkle! The diamonds are still rooting for you.
Fast enough for applause! Slightly too fast for that corner.
Clock reset! Let's make the next attempt wonderfully inconvenient for it.
Off we go again! This time, keep the caretaker attached.
